title: Colnect Stamp Condition Drift
dataSources: Discogs collection entries (`discogs:item`), comics (`comic:item`), coin catalogue entries (`coin:item`), stamp album entries (`stamp:item`), and watch logs (`watch:item`).
app: Collection telemetry from Discogs, Comic Vine, coin and stamp catalogues, and watch-collection trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=stamp:item
| search condition_score=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(condition_score) as avg_condition_score min(condition_score) as min_condition_score by _time album_name
| sort - _time
description: Tracks stamp condition drift over time and breaks it out by album.
value: Condition drift lets you see whether one album or storage method is aging worse than the rest.
implementation: Send stamp condition drift events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of stamp condition drift by album.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates how stamp condition drift changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
